required_identity: rvLLM test executable and generated-source/AIR/metallib SHA256
same complete operation and precision boundaries

ffn.operation: Gate||Up matmul with explicit BF16 boundary, incumbent clamped tanh GELU(gate)*up, final BF16
ffn.include: both projections plus activation and output materialization; never activation-only

global_attention.storage: BF16 Q/K/V, FP32 softmax, BF16 final output
global_attention.mask: only position-visible non-hole keys; define all-hole zero result explicitly
global_attention.math_only: contiguous gather outside timer must be disclosed; not the same paged operation
global_attention.full_paged_operation: include gather/layout/mask materialization and synchronization costs; retain owner cache-write cost separately if common to both

group32_qmv.rvllm_storage: signed nibble/byte weights; group-32 FP16 scales; BF16 activation/output
group32_qmv.mlx_storage_warning: MLX affine quantized_matmul packed uint32 weights plus scales/biases is not automatically equivalent
group32_qmv.required_adapter_gate: lossless reconstruction over every weight and scale, layout/group/tail proof, unchanged checkpoint identity, equivalent precision/rounding; otherwise reject same-storage label

evaluation: build fresh complete operations, force output evaluation and synchronize; repeated eval of cached arrays is not a sample

sampling.promising_rule: drift <= 0.05 AND ABBA median > 1 AND BAAB median > 1 AND whole-block bootstrap lower 95% endpoint > 1
